limitations.description: Consecutive +30s targets overlap heavily. The frozen circular-shift null preserves within-session target order and dependence except at one circular boundary, but the nominal sample count is not an independent-observation count.
Eight sessions provide about 24 hours across three UTC dates and seven held-out folds, limiting regime breadth.
Frozen pooled Spearman and MSE weight sessions by available sample count rather than equally by session; observed session lengths are similar.
The frozen circular-shift null assumes within-session rotation is an appropriate stationarity-based null and introduces one wrap boundary per session.
The model OOS MSE improvement is 0.4033958454650646%; the frozen gate requires strict improvement and does not impose an economic-magnitude threshold.

The sealed report does not retain per-fold predictions, per-session correlations, individual null statistics, the evaluated source commit, or the runtime version, limiting independent forensic reconstruction without a prohibited rerun.

research_interpretation: V9 establishes confirmatory predictive L2 information only. It does not establish trading profitability, executable edge, or robustness after costs.
next_stage: Separately preregister a cost-aware trading hypothesis and evaluate it using genuinely new prospective sessions. These eight consumed sessions must not be presented as fresh independent validation evidence.
